description.value: Calico Cat Tea House is a tea-focused cafe in Nanaimo's Haliburton Street neighbourhood, open Wednesday through Sunday. It offers a relaxed, specialty tea experience that would make a pleasant mid-ride stop for cyclists exploring the city. The intimate setting is typical of a neighbourhood tea room.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned a security block page (redirected to cf.miniroad.store, flagged as potentially malicious) rather than actual business content, making it functionally equivalent to a fetch failure. All amenity fields must rely on OSM tags alone, which provide only name, address, phone, cuisine=tea, and opening hours. No OSM tags confirm bike parking, washrooms, wi-fi, or any other amenity. The business appears open per OSM (looks_closed=false, opening_hours present) and is a plausible real tea house cafe in Nanaimo.
concerns: Website https://www.calicocatteahouse.com/ appears to have been compromised or hijacked — the fetched content is entirely a security warning page redirecting to cf.miniroad.store, a flagged malicious domain. No actual business content could be retrieved. The website URL should be verified before publishing the directory listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open tea house cafe in Nanaimo with OSM presence, phone number, and opening hours. No evidence of closure.
